chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-'Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a woman whose menstruation had ceased for years, then some of it returned to her. He said: "She leaves the salat (prayer) until she becomes pure."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman's menstruation returns after having stopped for years?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman whose menstrual bleeding had stopped for years and then returned. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that if such bleeding appears, she must leave the salat (prayer) until she attains ritual purity. The narration falls under the jurisprudence of hayd and its effect on worship.
